SELECT join_date, COUNT(*) AS version_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, MIN(valid_from) mn, MAX(valid_from) mx
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-08'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT m.home_store_id, s.store_name, s.region, COUNT(*) n, MIN(m.valid_from) vf, MAX(m.valid_to) vt, SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cur
FROM dim_member m LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE m.join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1

SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) c, MIN(join_date) mnj, MAX(join_date) mxj
FROM dim_member
WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' OR valid_from = DATE '2026-10-03')
GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1 OR MIN(join_date)<>MAX(join_date)

SELECT 'dm_dupe_ids' k, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_join_oct3', COUNT(*) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03'
UNION ALL SELECT 'valid_from_oct3_joined_earlier', COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from = DATE '2026-10-03' AND join_date < DATE '2026-10-03'
UNION ALL SELECT 'joined_oct3_valid_from_not_oct3', COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND valid_from <> DATE '2026-10-03'
